classifications.CANONICAL_SUCCESS: T=64, Delta=0, complete observer, no known state-changing hazard; grounded RELEASE_ONLY is allowed
classifications.KNOWN_STATE_CHANGE: verified epoch contains source-grounded target stock drain, owner refill/Q64, PTE growth, or another named invalidator
classifications.UNEXPLAINED_BOUNDARY_DEVIATION: complete zero-miss epoch has T != 64 and no known state-changing event
classifications.TRUE_TARGET_FAIL: complete zero-miss target mismatch with T=64 and no known state-changing or unknown emission evidence
classifications.UNKNOWN_COMPLETE_EMISSION: trace/probe coverage is complete but an owner event remains semantically unclassified; preserve raw stack and do not call FAIL
classifications.INSTRUMENTATION_HOLD: probe miss, marker gap, incomplete owner identity, CPU/worker observation fault
classifications.PREVERIFY_HOLD: identity never reaches a clean VERIFIED state and is excluded from age contrast
